scientific_question: Does removing hidden reasoning from supervised trajectory targets improve fresh-task transfer of the H1.11 positive signal?
hypothesis: H1.11 fitted hidden reasoning and action jointly; projecting each target to the verified canonical action will reduce policy drift and improve compact-v2 closed-loop transfer.

source_panel.projection: retain original prompt/state; replace response with the exact fallback-free parsed action string; no hidden reasoning tokens

frozen_variables.training_budget: rank 4 q_proj/v_proj; one epoch; four optimizer steps; bfloat16; identical FAILURE/SUCCESS budget

cell_design: 3 supervision arms x 2 held-out partitions = 6 cells; 16 attempts/cell; 96 total

result.claim_boundary: Action-target projection diagnosis only; no benchmark/generalization claim, no D0 opening.

branch_rule.action_projection_helps: SUCCESS-ACTION-ONLY beats BASE and FAILURE-ACTION-ONLY on both partitions: proceed to independent confirmation; D0 remains closed
branch_rule.partial_or_task_specific: retain projection as task-specific evidence; no generalization claim
branch_rule.no_transfer: stop direct supervision projection and move to a new state/critic design; no hyperparameter sweep

claim_boundary: Action-target projection diagnosis only; no benchmark/generalization claim, no D0 opening, no SEED comparison.
